# FeatureFusion

> .NET engineering lab that extracts focused MIT BuildingBlocks (Mediator, Idempotency, keyset pagination, MCP, OpenTelemetry, Aspire SigNoz). The application is the laboratory; NuGet is the reusable result.

## Canonical

- [README](https://github.com/Maxofpower/FeatureFusion/blob/main/README.md): lab + package overview (versions below)
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Maxofpower/FeatureFusion/blob/main/AGENTS.md): repo map for coding agents
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/Maxofpower/FeatureFusion/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): BuildingBlocks release notes
- [Medium](https://medium.com/@m2hweb86/featurefusion-an-engineering-lab-that-extracts-reusable-net-building-blocks-28152cafafb9): lab-to-package narrative
- [Writing catalog](https://github.com/Maxofpower/FeatureFusion/blob/main/docs/linkedin-posts.md): LinkedIn / Medium post ↔ code map
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/Maxofpower/FeatureFusion/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [web/README](https://github.com/Maxofpower/FeatureFusion/blob/main/web/README.md): reserved Next.js frontend root (not in the .NET solution)

## Packages (current versions)

| Package | Version | NuGet | GitHub releases |
|---------|---------|-------|-----------------|
| BuildingBlocks.Mediator | 1.1.0 | [nuget.org](https://www.nuget.org/packages/BuildingBlocks.Mediator/1.1.0) | [mediator-v*](https://github.com/Maxofpower/FeatureFusion/releases?q=mediator-v) |
| BuildingBlocks.Mcp | 1.0.0 | [nuget.org](https://www.nuget.org/packages/BuildingBlocks.Mcp/1.0.0) | [mcp-v*](https://github.com/Maxofpower/FeatureFusion/releases?q=mcp-v) |
| BuildingBlocks.Idempotency | 1.0.1 | [nuget.org](https://www.nuget.org/packages/BuildingBlocks.Idempotency/1.0.1) | [idempotency-v*](https://github.com/Maxofpower/FeatureFusion/releases?q=idempotency-v) |
| BuildingBlocks.Pagination.EntityFrameworkCore | 1.1.0 | [nuget.org](https://www.nuget.org/packages/BuildingBlocks.Pagination.EntityFrameworkCore/1.1.0) | [pagination-v*](https://github.com/Maxofpower/FeatureFusion/releases?q=pagination-v) |
| BuildingBlocks.Telemetry | 1.0.2 | [nuget.org](https://www.nuget.org/packages/BuildingBlocks.Telemetry/1.0.2) | [telemetry-v*](https://github.com/Maxofpower/FeatureFusion/releases?q=telemetry-v) |
| BuildingBlocks.Aspire.Hosting.SigNoz | 1.0.0 | [nuget.org](https://www.nuget.org/packages/BuildingBlocks.Aspire.Hosting.SigNoz/1.0.0) | [signoz-v*](https://github.com/Maxofpower/FeatureFusion/releases?q=signoz-v) |

**Highlights:** Pagination **1.1.0** — any-width Npgsql row comparison, `NULLS FIRST/LAST` interceptor, `HasKeysetIndex` + `NullOrder`. Idempotency **1.0.1** — package icon, System.Text.Json only (no Newtonsoft).
